experiments.afterUnblock: Exact strategy surface and exact break-even jackpot; no Monte Carlo required for the core hand decision.

experiments.afterUnblock: Exact meter-state EV and optimal threshold per bet level.

experiments.goal: Replay millions of hypothetical post-GHT races using only prospectively measured own latency and competitor/award timing; estimate probability our first eligible bet wins the race and profit distribution.
experiments.afterUnblock: Conservative race probability bound compared to exact break-even probability.

experiments.goal: Same race framework as AP McCoy but with exact bet365 served stake/runtime semantics.
Generate fair-wheel controls, test candidate bias rules against prospective exact-source outcomes, correct for thousands of attempted patterns and reject systems that only fit history.
experiments.hardTruth: No staking progression can turn an exactly fair roulette process positive EV. Only a verified physical/source-specific distributional deviation or rule/payoff error can create an edge.
blockedBy: prospective exact wheel/source stream if a real bias hypothesis exists

experiments.goal: Exhaustively evaluate current prize rules, rollovers, rolldowns, carrydowns and participation-dependent overlays; simulate ticket portfolios only after a rule discontinuity is identified.
experiments.hardTruth: Historical number patterns do not predict independent future draws; the lab searches payoff-rule edge, not magic numbers.

experiments.goal: For every exact MHB/MWB game, solve current-meter state against reset/increment/hazard/stake economics and stress-test bankroll before any prospective promotion.

globalProtocol.discovery: Large strategy/parameter search allowed only on synthetic/discovery data.
globalProtocol.freeze: Chosen strategy and parameters are cryptographically/version frozen before validation.
globalProtocol.validation: Fresh seeds or independent data; no retuning after results are seen.
globalProtocol.prospectiveShadow: Run the frozen policy against real observed states without wagering.
globalProtocol.executionReview: Separate execution contract only after exact current rules/state plus prospective evidence; simulator itself never authorizes a wager.
